Axiom: Before creating something new, search for an existing equivalent and reuse or merge rather than duplicate. Applied to code, not ticket text: before accepting a new symbol, search the repo for an existing equivalent. Applied at the reconciliation layer itself: two lens findings about the same file:line are ONE finding, not two duplicate `proposedActions` entries. Reuses the `ax-ticket-deduplication` principle (single authoritative home for one piece of content, whether that content is spec text, a code symbol, or a reconciled finding) — no separate axiom is authored for this, the same principle is read verbatim below.
